content.text: Nothing is below the concept, but three additions go beyond it: an open question asking the customer to re-confirm a fixed rounding rule, a confession that the plan does not answer the reporting workflow, and a characterisation of what the environment is not suitable for. Removing all three leaves every statement true, so none of them is holding up a real result — they are a lever to reopen fixed scope. H6 fails. Recording a HOLD with the punch-list.
